caption:
Do not compare blenders on peak wattage alone. Pick the form factor first, prefer a jar with a tamper, and look for five years or more of warranty on the motor base. Claude and GPT choose the same product: Vitamix 5200.
Type 1billionmodels.com/household-blenders for every pick and check. https://1billionmodels.com/home-and-kitchen/kitchen-and-dining/kitchen-small-appliances/household-blenders?src=youtube&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice.
title: Buying a blender? Don't compare peak watts
